signals.verdict: TESTED 2026-08-05 against a hashed pre-registration, then RE-RUN THE SAME DAY on a CORRECTED primary outcome (sigtest/prereg_amendment.json A1: the old outcome carried the entry half of the toll inside its denominator) — FAILED both times, 0 survivors both times. Not wired into any gate, sizing or selection path. Recorded so it accumulates toward n>=300.
signals.outcome_definition: exit_price / px_in - 1 — a TRUE gross price move. The earlier definition (exit_price / entry - 1) had the entry-side toll inside its denominator and was then compared against a full round-trip toll, double-charging the entry push by ~2.2pp at the median.

underpowered_excluded_from_best.why: n=23 is below the pre-registered minimum of 30; it could not have survived at any p, so its favoured-half move is not the family best

exploratory_killed.label: hours to first reach $25k depth
exploratory_killed.status: KILLED — exploratory, 1 hit in 46 trials, failed OOS and every strip test
exploratory_killed.note: On the CORRECTED outcome it no longer clears BH either (p_bh 0.0966). And its sign is POSITIVE — more hours to reach $25k predicts a BETTER outcome — the OPPOSITE of the direction H1/H2 pre-register from Marino et al. Even had it been registered it would have failed S3 (sign) regardless of p. It is not a discarded Marino effect; it points the other way.

coverage.note: a field can be null on a row that exists (nothing to measure) or the whole row can be missing (collector never reached this buy) — these are different failures and are counted separately on purpose
